title: MoHUA — Urban Challenge Fund (UCF) projects for Ahmedabad
summary: **₹2,719.80 Cr** approved for 6 urban projects in Ahmedabad — part of Gujarat's ₹6,475 Cr UCF allocation.

blocks.content: **₹2,719.80 Cr** approved for 6 urban projects in Ahmedabad — part of Gujarat's ₹6,475 Cr UCF allocation.

items: UCF: Central Assistance ₹1 lakh Cr, total investment target ₹4 lakh Cr (FY26-FY31).

blocks.content: 💼 Interview Q → What is the Urban Challenge Fund? *A: A Centrally Sponsored Scheme (₹1 lakh Cr central assistance) approved Feb 2026 to drive ₹4 lakh Cr urban investment over FY26-31, with Centre funding up to 25% of project cost.*
